Around [[25,200 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was '''bombarded''' by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was suffering a [[Rakatan plague|plague]] that was reducing their numbers and stripping them of their ability to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]], who lived on Tatooine and had fought the Rakata<ref name="KOTOR" /> ever since they had [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquered]] Tatooine in [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="DOTJ 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> used the plague as an opportunity to sabotage Rakatan ships, and the Rakata retaliated by bombarding Tatooine. The bombardment covered Tatooine in glass. Over the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the glass developed into a planet-wide desert,<ref name="KOTOR" /> and the Kumumgah evolved into two species: the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> By the time [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] traveled to Tatooine during his quest for the Rakatan [[Star Map]]s, only basic information about this conflict managed to survive in the form of oral history told by the Tusken Raiders' [[The Storyteller (Sand People)|Storyteller]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
